title: Build suits in the case register, case verdict, the notice task and the judge seat draft (design T-452)
description: T-452 section 9, items 1, 3 and 4. The judge seat needs a warrant the operator signs; this task drafts it and signs nothing.
acceptance_criteria: precedent.py case open accepts optional suit fields (claimant, respondent, contract, damages_claimed) stored as one suit block in the same case record. A case opened without them is byte-for-byte the old schema, pinned by a test. damages_claimed is informational: a test pins that nothing reads it to compute anything.

precedent.py case verdict --case --judge --seq --task disposes the case through the existing dispose_case with verb verdict. It refuses: an act that is not kind verdict; an act that does not verify under the judge name's key; a judge name not issued in the judge colegiado; a task mismatch; a case already disposed (the T-412 S-1 refusal, reused); a verdict act already disposing another case.

Notice: a verb (for example precedent.py case notice) that creates the board task titled 'NOTICE to <respondent>: answer suit <case> by <deadline>' through blackboard.py add-task, role worker, engine any, no dependencies. Until decision 10 is ratified the deadline reads 'window not ratified'.

Judge seat: the roster.py charter and plazas commands for a judge colegiado as T-452 section 3 drafts it, and an UNSIGNED warrant payload produced by warrant.py draft, saved as a draft file under .harness/ with the exact command the operator runs to sign it. Nothing is signed and the live roster is not mutated. The recusal check is a short written checklist, not a gate (PR-017).
Tests in a throwaway root cover the happy path (suit opened, judge issued under a throwaway root, intent declared, verdict signed, case verdict disposes) and every refusal above.
Edit precedent.py, new tests and new draft or doc files only; attest.py belongs to T-466. Do not edit CLAUDE.md. The suite passes via goal_mode. Hand off to verifier.

1) SUIT FIELDS (case open). precedent.open_case()/cmd_case_open gained optional --claimant/--respondent/--contract/--damages-claimed, stored as rec["suit"]={claimant,respondent,contract,damages_claimed} only when at least one is given. Replay:
   python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py case open --question q --task T-1 --root <reg> --harness-root <hroot>              # old schema, no "suit" key
   python3 .harness/bin/precedent.py case open --question q --task T-1 --claimant a --respondent b --contract T-100 --damages-claimed "40 tokens" --root <reg> --harness-root <hroot>
   Pinned: TheSuitFields.test_a_case_opened_with_no_suit_fields_is_byte_for_byte_the_old_schema (exact key-set check), test_a_case_opened_with_suit_fields_stores_one_suit_block, test_a_partial_suit_block_still_writes_one_dict_with_the_rest_none. damages_claimed is informational only: test_damages_claimed_is_never_read_by_the_disposal_or_verdict_machinery asserts "damages" does not appear in inspect.getsource() of dispose_case/cmd_case_verdict/validate_case_for_disposal/_ref_already_disposes_a_case.

2) CASE VERDICT. New `precedent.py case verdict --case --judge --seq --task [--harness-root] [--root]`, cmd_case_verdict. Looks up act #seq on judge's attest chain, then refuses, IN ORDER: (a) act not found; (b) act.kind != "verdict"; (c) attest._verify_sig fails under the judge's own enrolled/delegated pubkey (attest.signing_keys); (d) judge not issued into the "judge" colegiado in roster.json (new _judge_issue_check, a REFUSAL gate unlike classify_seat/eligible_report's report-only posture); (e) act["task"] != --task; (f) case already disposed (validate_case_for_disposal, the T-412/S-1 refusal, reused unchanged); (g) the verdict act (ref="{judge}_{seq}") already disposes a DIFFERENT case (new _ref_already_disposes_a_case). On success calls the existing dispose_case(verb="verdict", ref="{judge}_{seq}", ...) unchanged. Computes NO deadline/lapse/damages amount anywhere -- pinned by TheVerdict.test_damages_cap_and_windows_are_never_computed_here (source scan for "deadline"/"lapse"/the three proposed numbers). All 7 scenarios + happy path covered in TheVerdict (test_precedent_t468_suits.py), built against a throwaway root with a REAL warrant.py draft/sign/apply flow (never the operator's key). Replay the suite directly:
   python3 -m pytest .harness/tests/test_precedent_t468_suits.py -q

3) CASE NOTICE. New `precedent.py case notice --case --respondent --task-id [--agent] [--harness-root] [--root]`, cmd_case_notice. Refuses an unregistered --case; otherwise shells out to the REAL <harness-root>/bin/blackboard.py add-task (never writes a task file by hand) with title literally "NOTICE to <respondent>: answer suit <case> by window not ratified", --role worker --engine any, no --depends-on. The deadline slot is the module constant NOTICE_WINDOW_UNRATIFIED = "window not ratified" -- no date arithmetic exists anywhere in cmd_case_notice (TheNoticeVerb.test_the_deadline_is_the_literal_unratified_string_never_a_computed_date asserts no YYYY-MM-DD pattern appears). TheNoticeVerb copies the REAL .harness/bin/ into a throwaway <tmp>/.harness/bin/ (mirrors test_blackboard_redact.py's own pattern, since blackboard.py resolves hc.HARNESS from its own __file__ location, T-422) and asserts the LIVE .harness/blackboard.json's task set is unchanged after the call. Replay:
   python3 -m pytest .harness/tests/test_precedent_t468_suits.py::TheNoticeVerb -q

   run against the live .harness root (consistent with .harness/OPERATOR-ENROLMENT.md's own documented live-draft workflow, and with the existing precedent of W-001.json sitting unsigned in the live tree since gen-6).
